question: Where’s the closest hotel you hit on the way to River Edge Bird Sanctuary and Nature Trail, River Edge, NJ from American Folk Art Museum, New York, NY?
sql:
WITH
    angle AS (SELECT degrees(ST_Azimuth(ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-73.981596 40.77323)',4326)::geography, ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-74.046703 40.915888)',4326)::geography)) AS value)
SELECT * FROM pois,angle
WHERE tourism = 'hotel'
AND (degrees(ST_Azimuth(ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-73.981596 40.77323)',4326)::geography, pois.geometry)) BETWEEN angle.value - 22.5 AND angle.value + 22.5)
ORDER BY pois.geometry <-> ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-73.981596 40.77323)',4326)::geography ASC
LIMIT 1;

[2].display_name: American Folk Art Museum, New York, NY

[3].display_name: River Edge Bird Sanctuary and Nature Trail, River Edge, NJ

poi.poi_name: River Edge Bird Sanctuary and Nature Trail
